wps.focus: Change no code. Run and record pass/fail counts (and names of pre-existing failures) in your hand-off note: tests/test_sca_protocol.py, tests/test_clipboard_assist.py, tests/test_clipboard_clear_setting.py, tests/test_sca_suppress_client.py, tests/test_sca_uid_source_watch.py, tests/test_service_automation_mode.py, tests/test_ws_bridge.py, tests/test_ui_scale.py, every tests/test_scc_*.py, and `node tests/js/test_sca_coordinator.js`. Create core/os_assist/__init__.py, core/os_assist/worker.py and core/os_assist/locate.py. worker.py: one daemon thread owning its own UIA object (CoInitialize + CUIAutomation8, fallback CUIAutomation, as core/sca/page_nodes.UiaReader does), a job queue, `submit(fn, *args) -> concurrent.futures.Future`, `stop()`; never vsdc_uia_text's shared worker. locate.py (runs on the worker): `browser_windows()` (visible top-level windows of BROWSER_EXE_NAMES from core/vsdc/vsdc_router), `read_url(hwnd)` via vsdc_uia_text.address_bar_here, `window_for_host(host_or_url) -> hwnd|0` (foreground window first, D4), `host_matches_service(hwnd, service)` using sca_protocol.host_matches on the service's login_page_link, `page_documents(hwnd)` (on-screen Documents, skip NativeViewHost), `find_fields(hwnd, username_selector, password_selector) -> (user_el, pass_el)` with the §4.2 rules (#id selector -> AutomationId; ignore other selector shapes), and `page_rect(hwnd)` (the on-screen Document's bounding rect, for docking). Read-only: no pattern method calls here. Tests in tests/test_os_assist_locate.py with fake elements: decoys skipped (hiddenPassword, aria hidden, zero size, offscreen, disabled), username-before-password, PAN page with no password box, #id selector wins, non-#id selector ignored.

Read docs/os_assist/os-assist-blueprint.md §0, §4.1, §4.3 and the spike's fill_one/verify/check/type_text/focus_mode. Create core/os_assist/fill.py (runs on the worker): `fill(hwnd, element, text, is_password, service, method='auto') -> FillResult(outcome, method, reason)` with outcome filled|failed|refused; the host check before EACH write (rule 3); SetValue then verify at 0.15 s and 1.0 s; the D2 bullet-count check for password boxes (never compare or keep the text read back); SendInput fallback with KEYEVENTF_UNICODE, focus check via CompareElements, abort when the foreground window changes. Also `type_into_focused(hwnd, text, is_password, service)` and `FocusWatcher` for the Flutter step mode (§4.3: 200 ms GetFocusedElement poll, ignores the address bar, reports each new Edit once). SendInput and the window calls go through a small injectable `keyboard` object so tests can fake them. Never log or print a value. Tests in tests/test_os_assist_fill.py with fakes: SetValue ok; SetValue ignored -> keys fallback; read-only -> keys; host changed between find and write -> refused; window changed mid-type -> failed; password verify uses length only; method='setvalue' never types. Add tests/test_os_assist_one_writer.py: scans every .py under the repo (skip venv, .build_venv, backups, .restore_points, build, dist, tests) and fails if `SetValue(`, `SendInput` or `.SetFocus(` appears outside core/os_assist/fill.py and tools/pre_dev/os_assist/.

Read docs/os_assist/os-assist-blueprint.md §4.5 and how the app clears copied passwords today (grep clipboard_clear in clipboard_watch.py, ui/dialogs/unified_settings_dialog.py, tests/test_clipboard_clear_setting.py). Create core/os_assist/secure_clipboard.py: `copy(text, secret: bool, clear_after_s: int|None)` on the Qt main thread with QMimeData: text/plain plus, when secret, the formats ExcludeClipboardContentFromMonitorProcessing (empty), CanIncludeInClipboardHistory and CanUploadToCloudClipboard (each a 4-byte little-endian DWORD 0) — check Qt writes custom Windows formats with the `application/x-qt-windows-mime;value="<Name>"` mime name and use that. Clear after clear_after_s only if the clipboard still holds that text (compare in memory, never log). Tests in tests/test_os_assist_clipboard.py (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen): formats present when secret, absent when not, clear only when unchanged.

Review core/os_assist/ against docs/os_assist/os-assist-blueprint.md §0 and §4.1–4.3, 4.5. Look for: any value logged or printed; a write without the host check just before it; UIA calls off the worker thread; SetValue/SendInput outside fill.py; field rules that differ from sera_dom.js isVisible/findField; COM objects leaking across threads. Fix what you find (small, with tests), run the phase-1 tests and the O0-1 list, and write what you checked in the hand-off note.

wps.what: ui/os_assist/dock_card.py: the docked, no-focus base window (§4.4)
wps.focus: Read docs/os_assist/os-assist-blueprint.md §4.4. Create ui/os_assist/__init__.py and ui/os_assist/dock_card.py: `DockCard(QWidget)` base: frameless, translucent background, Qt.Tool, Qt.WindowDoesNotAcceptFocus, WA_ShowWithoutActivating, and WS_EX_NOACTIVATE set with SetWindowLongPtrW after the native window exists; `attach(browser_hwnd, service)` sets GWLP_HWNDPARENT to the browser; a 100 ms QTimer while visible: follows GetWindowRect / the page rect (ask the worker for locate.page_rect at most every 500 ms), hides while the browser is minimised (IsIconic) or closed (IsWindow), hides when the address-bar host stops matching the service and shows again when it matches; anchored top-right with the extension's offsets (top 18 px, right 24 px, DPI-scaled with the app's scale helpers). Shared pieces every card uses: slide-in from the right (0.38 s cubic-bezier feel via QPropertyAnimation), `TimerBar` (scaleX countdown, pause on hover, resume, reset on click, expiry -> dismiss()), header with badge + ✎ + ✕, and a `dismissed` signal that clears any secret the card holds. No card content yet. Tests in tests/test_os_assist_dock_card.py (offscreen): flags set, timer pause/resume/reset/expiry, hide on host mismatch via a fake locator, dismiss clears secrets.

Read docs/os_assist/os-assist-blueprint.md §2 (SMTI row), §4.3 Flutter, §4.4, §6 D3, and background.js manualAssistWidget (~L807–1556: its CSS is the visual spec — colours, sizes, fonts, emoji labels, button states done/warn/primary, timer durations). Create ui/os_assist/smti_card.py on DockCard: badge '⚡ Sera Assist', client title, '👤  Username' and '🔑  Password' buttons. Username click: reset timer, worker -> locate.find_fields + fill.fill(user); filled -> '✓  Username Injected' 2 s; no box or failed -> secure_clipboard.copy (not secret) and '📋  Copied Username (Ctrl+V)' 2.5 s. Password click: filled -> dismiss; else secure copy (secret, clipboard-clear seconds) + '📋  Copied Password (Ctrl+V)' then dismiss after 1.2 s. Flutter mode (service host is tdscpc.gov.in / traces, or the page has no Edit until one is focused): hide the buttons, show the two step cards with the same texts and active/done styles, run fill.FocusWatcher. D3 (settled by the owner 2026-11-08): keep the ✎ button on every OS card; it does exactly what it does today — it opens the SCK widget for this client and service (the same path as main.py _handle_sck_edit_requested -> automation.show_sck_widget(service, client_id, client_name, portal); call that handler's logic directly, no socket). Build it as a shared helper in dock_card.py that the MECP and SCA cards reuse. Do NOT ask about D3. The card never touches the extension for filling. Tests in tests/test_os_assist_smti_card.py with a fake worker/fill: button texts and states, copy fallbacks, dismiss on password, Flutter step flow, secrets cleared.

Create ui/os_assist/mecp_card.py on DockCard. Plain: rows 'User ID (PAN)' and 'Password' with '📋 Copy' -> secure_clipboard.copy (password secret) -> '✓ Copied' then back; 90 s timer; closes when done the same way the extension card does today (check its code). SCC mode: combo rows with Copy and 'This one worked', 'None - I typed my own', failed rows marked '✗', note line, the same messages to the desktop the extension card sends today (find them in background.js / ui/ws_bridge.py and call the same main.py handlers directly instead of a socket). Copies in SCC mode also call the SccCard ledger directly (§4.5). Values shown on the card are as today (the card shows them). Never log them. Tests in tests/test_os_assist_mecp_card.py with fakes.

wps.what: SMTI/MECP launch through the OS engine
wps.focus: Read docs/os_assist/os-assist-blueprint.md §3, §4.4, §4.7 and automation.py trigger_manual_assist / trigger_mecp / _send_to_extension / open_in_default_browser, and how Client Detail and the Tracker Dump call them (ui/windows/client_detail_window.py, ui/windows/tracker_dump_window.py). Create core/os_assist/launcher.py: `launch(kind 'smti'|'mecp', service, user_id, password, client_id, client_name, on_error)` — open_in_default_browser(login url) (new tab each time, owner answer 3), wait up to 20 s on the worker for a browser window whose address bar matches the service host (window_for_host), then show the card on the Qt main thread attached to that hwnd; on timeout call on_error with a clear message. One live card per kind: a new launch dismisses the old one (and clears its secret). Card lifetimes as today (SMTI duration the desktop passes today, MECP 90 s). In automation.trigger_manual_assist / trigger_mecp: if assist_engine()=='os' call the launcher, else the current extension path unchanged. Keep clipboard_watch.suppress_client behaviour for MECP/SMTI launches. Tests with fakes: OS path chosen only in OS mode, extension path untouched, timeout message, one card per kind, secrets cleared.

Create core/os_assist/sca_engine.py on the worker: holds the current arm (no passwords; as the extension keeps it), ticks ~0.6 s only while an arm is live, does steps 1–7 of §4.6, calls handle_password_request in-process with the same dict shape, fills with fill.fill, reports with handle_fill_result, shows sca_card / sca_chip on the Qt thread, respects the assist lock (an OS SMTI/MECP card open on that hwnd). In OS mode arms go to the engine instead of automation.arm_sca, and disarm/expiry behave as today; on switching to OS send update_extension_settings(sca_enabled=False), and back on switching to extension restore the user's SCA setting. Tests in tests/test_os_assist_sca_engine.py with fakes: match + autofill, needs_confirm card + Inject, blocked service notice once, wrong host ignored, non-approved domain ignored, one fill per arm/window/service, Income Tax two-page wait, assist lock, idle when no arm.
